description: This file implements a command queue system with lane-based concurrency control, error handling, and task management for an application. It defines classes for specific error types, manages queue state globally, and provides functions to enqueue, dequeue, reset, and monitor tasks within different lanes.

classes.name: CommandLaneClearedError
classes.description: Error thrown when a command lane is cleared before execution.

classes.name: GatewayDrainingError
classes.description: Error thrown when commands are rejected because the gateway is draining.

classes.name: ActiveTaskWaiter
classes.description: Internal type representing a waiter for active tasks to drain.

classes.name: LaneState
classes.description: Internal type representing the state of a command lane, including queue and active tasks.

classes.name: QueueEntry
classes.description: Internal type representing a queued command with its associated metadata.

methods.name: isExpectedNonErrorLaneFailure
methods.description: Checks if an error is a non-critical lane failure based on its name.

methods.name: getQueueState
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the global queue state singleton.

methods.name: normalizeLane
methods.description: Normalizes lane names by trimming and defaulting to 'main'.

methods.name: getLaneDepth
methods.description: Calculates the total number of tasks (active + queued) in a lane.

methods.name: getLaneState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the state object for a specific lane.

methods.name: completeTask
methods.description: Marks a task as completed and removes it from active tasks if generation matches.

methods.name: hasPendingActiveTasks
methods.description: Checks if there are any active tasks pending across all lanes.

methods.name: resolveActiveTaskWaiter
methods.description: Resolves a waiter for active tasks, indicating whether the queue is drained.

methods.name: notifyActiveTaskWaiters
methods.description: Notifies all waiters that active tasks have drained.

methods.name: drainLane
methods.description: Drains a lane by executing queued tasks respecting concurrency and handling errors.

methods.name: markGatewayDraining
methods.description: Sets the global state to indicate the gateway is draining for restart.

methods.name: setCommandLaneConcurrency
methods.description: Sets the maximum concurrency for a specific lane.

methods.name: enqueueCommandInLane
methods.description: Enqueues a command into a specified lane with optional warning callback.

methods.name: enqueueCommand
methods.description: Enqueues a command into the default 'main' lane.

methods.name: getQueueSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the queue for a specific lane.

methods.name: getTotalQueueSize
methods.description: Returns the total size of all queues across lanes.

methods.name: clearCommandLane
methods.description: Clears all queued commands in a specified lane, rejecting their promises.

methods.name: resetCommandQueueStateForTest
methods.description: Resets the entire queue state for testing purposes.

methods.name: resetAllLanes
methods.description: Resets all lane states to idle, increments generation, and drains lanes with queued tasks.

methods.name: getActiveTaskCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of active (running) tasks across all lanes.

methods.name: waitForActiveTasks
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when all active tasks have finished or timeout occurs.
